privacy.audienceP1: We measure the site's traffic ourselves, with no third-party tool, no cookie and no identifier of any kind. For each page view, we only record the page path (without parameters), its language, the domain name of the site you came from, and a screen size class (mobile, tablet, desktop).
privacy.audienceP2: This data is aggregated per day within minutes, after which the individual records are deleted. No IP address is kept: a non-reversible fingerprint, computed with a secret renewed every day, is only used to limit abuse for one minute. No cross-referencing with other processing is possible.
privacy.audienceP3: Purpose: site traffic statistics, exclusively. Legal basis: the association's legitimate interest; this measurement meets the conditions for exemption from consent set by the CNIL (the French data protection authority) for audience measurement. Aggregated statistics are kept for 13 months.
privacy.audienceP4: You can object at any time: the setting below, the “Essential only” choice in the banner, or your browser's “Do Not Track” / Global Privacy Control option turn the measurement off in this browser.
privacy.newsletterP1: Subscribing to the newsletter is a two-step process (double opt-in): you receive an email containing a single-use link, valid for 48 hours. Without confirmation, your address is deleted when the link expires, and you receive nothing.
privacy.newsletterP2: We keep proof of your consent (date, subscription form, language, version of the information notice) for as long as you are subscribed. Every mailing includes a one-click unsubscribe link; unsubscribing deletes your address.
privacy.newsletterP3: Legal basis: your consent. Technical recipient: our email delivery provider (Resend).
